type.description: Kind of record: interest (a keyword report from Explore) or trending (a trending search).

keyword.description: Interest records: the keyword or topic from the input.

searchedFor.description: Interest records: what Google Trends searched for: the keyword, or the topic ID.

topicTitle.description: Interest records: name of the topic, when a topic was searched; null for plain keywords.

topicType.description: Interest records: type of the topic, for example Beverage; null for plain keywords.

location.description: Country or region code, for example US or US-CA; empty for worldwide.

locationName.description: Name of the location, for example United States.

timeRange.description: Interest records: time range as Google writes it, for example today 12-m.

timeRangeName.description: Interest records: time range in words, for example Past 12 months.

startDate.description: Interest records: first date of the data (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: Interest records: last date of the data (YYYY-MM-DD).

resolution.description: Interest records: step of the time series: MINUTE, HOUR, DAY, WEEK or MONTH.

category.description: Interest records: ID of the Google Trends category; 0 for all categories.

categoryName.description: Interest records: name of the category.

searchType.description: Interest records: web, images, news, youtube or froogle (Google Shopping).

oneScale.description: Interest records: true when the keywords were compared on one scale, so their numbers can be compared directly.

comparedWith.description: Interest records: the other keywords of the comparison.

hasData.description: Interest records: false when Google Trends has too little data for the keyword.

averageInterest.description: Interest records: average interest over the time range, from 0 to 100.

peakInterest.description: Interest records: highest interest, from 0 to 100.

peakDate.description: Interest records: date of the highest interest.

latestInterest.description: Interest records: interest at the last complete point.

latestDate.description: Interest records: date of the last complete point.

recentChangePercent.description: Interest records: the last 4 points (7 for daily data) against the 4 (or 7) before them, in percent.

yearOverYearPercent.description: Interest records: the latest 12 months against the 12 months before, in percent; needs a time range of 2 years or more.

trendDirection.description: Interest records: rising (trend of +15% or more), falling (-15% or less) or stable, over the whole time range.

trendPercent.description: Interest records: change from start to end along a straight line through all points, in percent of the average.

bestMonth.description: Interest records: month of the year with the highest average interest; needs a time range of 2 years or more.

worstMonth.description: Interest records: month of the year with the lowest average interest; needs a time range of 2 years or more.

seasonalityPercent.description: Interest records: best month minus worst month, in percent of the average; high values mean a seasonal keyword.

topRegion.description: Interest records: region with the highest interest.

topRelatedQuery.description: Interest records: the most searched related query.

topRisingQuery.description: Interest records: the fastest growing related query.

interestOverTime.description: Interest records: the time series, each point with date, value (0 to 100) and isPartial.

interestByRegion.description: Interest records: interest by region, each with geoCode, geoName and value (0 to 100).

relatedQueriesTop.description: Interest records: the most searched related queries, each with query, value and Explore link.

relatedQueriesRising.description: Interest records: the fastest growing related queries, each with query, increase, increasePercent, isBreakout and Explore link.

newRisingQueries.description: Interest records: with Only new rising queries, the rising queries that earlier runs did not see; null otherwise.

trendsUrl.description: Interest records: link to the same report on Google Trends.

warnings.description: Interest records: notes on data Google Trends did not return, for example no regional breakdown; null when there are none.

hours.description: Trending records: time window of the trending searches, in hours (4, 24, 48 or 168).

rank.description: Trending records: position of the search, from 1.

searchVolume.description: Trending records: search volume, as a number.

searchVolumeText.description: Trending records: search volume as Google shows it, for example 500K+.

increasePercent.description: Trending records: growth of the search, in percent.

startedAt.description: Trending records: when the search started trending (ISO date and time).

endedAt.description: Trending records: when it stopped trending; null while it is still trending.

isActive.description: Trending records: true while the search is still trending.

categories.description: Trending records: categories of the search, for example Sports.

relatedSearches.description: Trending records: related searches that trend together with it.

exploreUrl.description: Trending records: link to the search on Google Trends Explore.
